agent.next_draft: Carry draft_json unchanged to the next stage. Explicitly choose source identity, unit, aggregation and candidate IDs; finish_binding_draft only proposes. Abstain when experimental identity is unclear.
agent.draft_start: Start a read-only staged mapping draft; return exact source samples and candidate IDs. No mapping is accepted.

agent.draft_derived: Add a difference, ratio, percentage_point_difference or relative_change_percent using two existing metric IDs.
agent.draft_locations: Select explicit candidate_ids and equally many distinct names for one metric; declare display_kind, places, percent_symbol and experiment-identity rationale. Ambiguous anchors are rejected.
agent.draft_finish: Validate the completed draft and return an unaccepted proposal_json for author review. This never writes files or accepts bindings.

document.PDF_NO_TEXT: PDF page {page} has no usable text layer. Scans and blank pages are not certified; OCR is not performed.
document.PDF_IMAGE_CONTENT: PDF page {page} contains images. Image content and possible OCR text are not verified.
document.PDF_COMPLEX_TABLE: PDF page {page} has an unsupported or ambiguous table region; it is not verified.
document.PDF_UNRELIABLE_TEXT: Some text on PDF page {page} has unreliable glyphs or coordinates and is not verified.
pdf.extraction_changed: The PDF binding for {file} has no matching extraction identity. Review and repair the binding with the current parser.
pdf.export_unchecked: Cannot compare {metric} between {source} and {file}: a binding is missing or unresolved. Bind the metric explicitly in both documents.
pdf.exports_note: This comparison covers explicitly bound metrics only. It does not prove that two documents are identical or that the whole paper is correct.
actions.detail_reexport_pdf: Review the source and export a fresh PDF. Recheck the new file; repair bindings if its layout or extraction identity changed.
manuscript.help: Manage manuscripts sharing one evidence configuration
manuscript.list: List declared manuscripts and export relationships
manuscript.add: Preview or accept adding a companion manuscript
manuscript.export_of: Explicit source .tex, .docx, .md or .qmd entry for this PDF
manuscript.remove_primary: Select a declared companion. The primary manuscript cannot be removed by this command.
manuscript.referenced: {file} still has bindings or export references. Update those declarations before removing it.
manuscript.inspect: Inspect PDF pages, numeric coordinates and limitations
manuscript.region-add: Preview or accept a named PDF region
manuscript.region-remove: Preview or accept removing a PDF region
pdf.help: Inspect PDF positions and declare bounded regions
pdf.bbox: PDF points from the top-left: x0 top x1 bottom
pdf.kind: Region interpretation; table requires a regular ruled grid
pdf.preview_note: Highlights use original page coordinates. Green: checked; red: mismatch; amber: unresolved or unbound. Only text with reliable positions is highlighted. Preview limits do not change check coverage.
pdf.preview_omitted: {count} additional pages omitted from the bounded preview. Their check results remain in this report.
pdf.preview_limit: Preview resource limit reached. Use the original file and reported coordinates.
pdf.preview_unavailable: Original-page preview is unavailable; numerical check results are unchanged. Use the file and coordinates shown in the report.
pdf.preview_changed: The PDF changed after checking. Preview omitted to avoid highlighting different bytes; run check again.
pdf.export_stale_finding: The declared source {source} agrees with the evidence for {metric}, but {file} still contains an outdated result. Re-export the PDF from the reviewed source.
document.PDF_FORM_CONTENT: Page {page} contains Form XObject content. Text inside its figure area is not verified.
pdf.region_table: Region {name} crosses a detected table. Select the entire grid with kind=table; text regions cannot hide table structure.
studio.title: Follow your results into the paper.
studio.subtitle: Connect evidence, compare experiments, and review the affected paper positions.
studio.changed: Project inputs have changed. Review a fresh scan before continuing.
studio.refresh_hint: Your staged draft is preserved. Rebuild selected declarations against current inputs, or explicitly refresh to start again; the old recovery copy is archived.
studio.setup_hint: Enter paths relative to this project folder. Creating a configuration does not confirm any bindings.
studio.data_paths: Evidence files · CSV / TSV / XLSX / JSON / experiment export · one path per line
studio.file_limit: Discovery is bounded. You can enter a project-relative path directly.
studio.initialized: Configuration created. Next, declare the evidence and its meaning.
studio.source_types_hint: Inspect the evidence rows and verify their column types and row identity. String IDs retain leading zeroes.
studio.source_staged: Source staged. It will be saved only with a selected binding that uses it.
studio.selector_hint: Enable every identity condition you need: model, dataset, split, variant. An unchecked column does not filter rows.
studio.expected_seeds: Expected seeds · one exact value per line
studio.metric_staged: Metric calculated and staged. Inspect its evidence, then choose the paper locations.
studio.add_derived: Derive a metric from two metrics
studio.binding_hint: Select the exact positions on the left. Equal numbers alone do not establish the same experiment.
studio.binding_name: Binding name / prefix for multiple locations
studio.percent_symbol: Include the percent sign in a percent display
studio.rationale: Why do these locations use this evidence?
studio.rationale_hint: Model, dataset, split, aggregation, and what these numbers mean…
studio.locations_staged: Staged {count} bindings. Preview them before saving.
studio.pdf_hint: Select highlighted numbers here or in the context list. The page is a read-only preview of the scanned input.
studio.review_hint: Preview runs the existing checker. Choose individual bindings and confirm their meaning before writing the configuration.
studio.attest: I have reviewed the selected experiment identities, evidence rows and paper locations.
studio.accept_hint: Saves selected bindings and their required metrics/sources, with a configuration backup. Unselected staged work is discarded. Paper and data files are unchanged.
studio.footer: Exact evidence · explicit confirmation · English / 简体中文
studio.primary_key_hint: Check the columns that together uniquely identify every table row.
studio.no_sources: No declared sources yet. Start by inspecting your data.
studio.no_metrics: No metrics yet. Declare the experiment and calculate its result.
studio.no_unsupported: No extraction issues reported by the current scan.
studio.candidate_limit: Showing the first {count} of {total} candidates. Use the CLI for the remaining positions or a smaller manuscript scope.
studio.json_pointer_hint: Use an exact JSON Pointer, for example /results/accuracy. JSON arrays require an explicit calculation and expected count.
studio.selection_limit: Stage at most 200 locations at once.
studio.no_locations: No unbound numbers match this filter. Try another file or show bound positions.
studio.page_unavailable: Page preview unavailable. Use the native position and context list.
studio.preview_empty: Stage one or more paper locations, then generate a fresh preview.
studio.preview_ready: Preview ready. No bindings are selected for saving automatically.
studio.choose_locations: Select at least one paper location.
studio.accepted_notice: Selected bindings saved. Current counts now use the accepted configuration.
studio.undone: Last stage undone. Accepted configuration is unchanged.
studio.refresh_confirm: Rescan the latest files and discard all staged work? Download a draft first if you need to keep it.
studio.draft_saved: Draft downloaded. Restore it with the same tool version and unchanged inputs.
studio.draft_loaded: Draft restored and input identities verified. Nothing accepted yet.
studio.draft_limit: This draft exceeds the browser import limit. Use the CLI builder for large drafts.
studio.report_saved: Downloaded a report of the accepted configuration, excluding staged bindings.
studio.setup_required: Create or load a project configuration first.
studio.stage_limit: The workbench holds at most 500 staged definitions. Save a smaller batch first.
studio.revision: This view is out of date. Reload the current session before editing.
studio.no_undo: There is no staged change to undo.
studio.preview_required: Generate and inspect a fresh preview before accepting bindings.
studio.page_missing: No scanned PDF locations exist on that page.
studio.draft_project: The draft must target this configuration and contain numeric binding stages only.
studio.request_denied: This request did not originate from the local workbench.
studio.not_found: This workbench resource does not exist.
studio.session_expired: Open the complete URL printed by the running studio command. Restarting the server creates a new session.
studio.io_error: A local file could not be read or saved. Check file access and reload the project.
studio.internal_error: The workbench could not finish this request. Rescan the project and retry.
studio.connection_error: Cannot reach the local studio. Keep its terminal running and reopen the printed URL.
studio.port_invalid: Port must be between 0 and 65535 (0 chooses an available port).
studio.cli_help: Open the local visual binding workbench
studio.port_help: Loopback port; 0 selects an available port (default)
studio.no_open_help: Print the URL without opening a browser
studio.stop_hint: Keep this terminal open. Press Ctrl+C to stop. Download unfinished drafts before stopping.
studio.open_failed: Open the printed URL in your browser.
maintenance.edit_required: Provide a reason and a replacement definition only when replacing.
maintenance.object: The replacement definition must be a JSON object.
maintenance.config_input: The configuration cannot also be an evidence input.
maintenance.unresolved: The replacement for {name} cannot be verified; resolve its inputs or location first.
maintenance.overlap: The replacement overlaps another accepted numeric binding.
maintenance.stale: Inputs changed after the maintenance preview; preview the changes again.
maintenance.identity: The maintenance proposal identity or tool version is invalid.
recovery.identity: The saved draft identity or project does not match.
recovery.input: A recovery file cannot overwrite a declared input.
recovery.limit: The saved draft exceeds the local recovery size limit.
recovery.conflict: Another session changed the saved draft. Reload its recovery information before continuing.
studio.finish_draft: Save or explicitly clear the staged additions before editing accepted declarations or manuscript files. A recovery copy is retained.
recovery.pending: Restore or explicitly discard the saved draft before staging new work.
studio.discard_recovery_confirm: Discard this saved draft? Download a recovery copy first if you still need it.
studio.recovery_hint: Restoring does not accept bindings. Changed inputs require a new review.
studio.snapshot_hint: A snapshot records the current evidence and check results, including failures and unknowns. Existing snapshots are never replaced.
studio.no_impacts: Connect evidence to paper positions to see impact groups here.
studio.manage_hint: Inspect dependencies and coverage before saving changes. Numeric precision and typed selectors remain exact.
studio.maintenance_attest: I reviewed the definition changes, affected declarations and coverage changes.
studio.coverage_change: Confirmed checks: {before} → {after}. Removed checks are no longer covered.
studio.repair_hint: Compare the previous wording with the current position. Repairing a position does not change its metric or edit the manuscript.
studio.repair_attest: I checked that the new position expresses the same declared result or comparison.
studio.claim_review_hint: A review record documents your inspection of this exact state. It does not turn a failed comparison into a pass.
studio.claim_attest: I reviewed this claim and its selected evidence.
studio.review_superseded: Evidence or wording changed since review
studio.no_claims: No comparison claims are declared in this project.
recovery.selection: Choose distinct declarations from the saved draft.
recovery.name: {name} now has a different accepted definition. Review or rename it before restoring.
recovery.already_accepted: The selected declarations are already accepted; no additions remain to restore.
studio.rebuild_hint: Choose declarations to recheck. Required dependencies are included. Leave broken positions unselected and choose their new positions after restoring the metrics.
studio.rebuild_attest: I checked the current definitions and evidence. Restore these as unaccepted staged additions.
studio.dependent_declarations: Declarations that depend on this item
studio.dependent_removal_hint: Select each dependent declaration to remove together. A preview with remaining references will be refused; no item is selected automatically.
studio.rechecked_files: Files involved in the last recheck: {count}
studio.batch_hint: Choose shared experiment conditions once, inspect each metric's evidence, then select its manuscript positions. Declare the table source in Evidence first. Use separate batches when units or aggregation conventions differ.
studio.batch_positions_hint: Context suggestions are not accepted bindings. Open a metric, review its identity and evidence, and explicitly select its positions. Equal numbers do not establish identity.
studio.batch_rationale: Reason for the selected correspondences (applies to this batch)
studio.batch_evidence_limit: Up to ten participating records are shown per evidence item; validation uses all selected records.
studio.batch_replace: Generating a new catalog clears the current batch's un-staged position choices. Continue?
studio.batch_generated: Experiment groups are ready. Select positions explicitly; changed form settings require a new inspection.
studio.batch_staged: Selected correspondences are saved as a recoverable draft. Preview and confirm the subset you want to accept.
studio.batch_stale: This batch belongs to an earlier draft or input state. Inspect the current experiment groups again.
studio.template_hint: Templates reuse field types, identity grouping, exact filters, units, aggregation, seeds and display settings. They contain no manuscript positions. Loading fills the form; review it and inspect current data again. Save under a new name to preserve an older template.
studio.template_loaded: Template settings are filled in. Check the source, exact filters and units, then inspect the current experiment groups.
studio.template_saved: Template saved locally. Download it to reuse these settings in another project with a compatible source declaration.
studio.template_identity: The template's identity does not match its content.
studio.template_contract: The selected source must preserve the template's declared column types and primary key. Declare a compatible source or create a new template.
studio.template_limit: Use a template file of at most 64 KiB and at most 100 saved templates per project.
studio.template_name: Use a template name starting with a letter and containing only letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens (at most 100 characters).
studio.proposal_loaded: Proposal verified and saved as a recoverable draft. Nothing has been accepted. Select the bindings to keep and confirm their evidence and meaning.
xlsx.structure: The XLSX file is damaged, oversized or uses an unsupported workbook structure.
xlsx.range: Select an explicit rectangular range such as A1:F20, including a header and at least one data row (at most 100,000 data rows and 1,000,000 cells).
xlsx.sheet: Worksheet {sheet} is not available. Choose one of: {choices}.
xlsx.macros: Macro-enabled workbooks are outside static XLSX evidence support. Export a values-only XLSX table.
xlsx.cell: Worksheet {sheet}, cell {cell} has an unsupported static value type: {kind}.
xlsx.date: Worksheet {sheet}, cell {cell} uses a date/time value or display. Use an explicit text identity or numeric result column.
xlsx.formula: Worksheet {sheet}, cell {cell} contains or controls a formula in the selected range. Cached formula results are not accepted; export reviewed static values.
xlsx.merged: Worksheet {sheet}, merged range {cell} intersects the selected result table. Use an unmerged table with one explicit header per column.
xlsx.header: The first row of the selected XLSX range must contain unique, nonempty text column headers.
xlsx.selection: An XLSX source needs an explicit worksheet and rectangular cell_range, including its header row.
xlsx.only: Worksheet and cell_range settings apply only to XLSX sources.
xlsx.text_identity: Worksheet {sheet}, cell {cell} stores a number but the column is declared as text. Store identifiers as actual text; display formatting does not establish identity.
evidence.schema: TSV, XLSX and normalized experiment sources require configuration schema 5.
evidence.report_schema: Native table evidence and import provenance require report schema 5.
evidence.key_missing: A required record identity is missing in {path}. Missing values are not converted to zero or empty text.
guide.cell_range: Enter the rectangular cell range, including headers (for example A1:F20).
studio.xlsx_hint: Choose the exact worksheet and range. Use static values with unmerged text headers; formula caches and dates are not result evidence.
studio.export_contract: Column types and row keys come from the declared export request. Create a new export to change them.
export.schema: Invalid, damaged or unsupported experiment export.
export.selection: Declare an explicit file source, or a provider endpoint with distinct run IDs, metric names and supported identity fields.
export.endpoint: Use an HTTPS provider URL (HTTP is allowed for localhost), without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
export.limit: The import exceeds its bounded size, page or record limit. Select fewer runs or metrics.
export.identity: The source snapshot, run identity or export hash does not match.
export.identity_type: Identity field {field} does not match its declared scalar type; numeric formatting is not a text identity.
export.pagination: Incomplete or repeating experiment-history pagination; no export was saved.
export.projection: Normalized rows or types do not match the stored source snapshots and import selection.
export.request: {provider} import failed ({status}). Check the endpoint, access and provider availability; credentials are not included in this error.
export.scalar: A selected experiment field is not a supported scalar. Export numeric measurements and explicit text/integer identity fields.
export.wandb_key: Set WANDB_API_KEY in the import process environment before importing from W&B.
export.wandb_dependency: Install the optional W&B adapter: python -m pip install "paperdelta[wandb]".
export.active_run: The selected run is still active. Import after it reaches a terminal state.
export.incomplete: The provider reports logged steps but returned an empty history. No export was saved.
export.suffix: Save the portable export with the .pdevidence.json suffix.
export.exists: Output already exists: {path}. Choose a new export path.
export.contract: Source column types and primary key must match the export contract.
export.key_missing: An experiment export row has a missing primary-key value.
export.duplicate: Experiment export row identities must be unique.
export.provenance: Normalized experiment evidence needs consistent source provenance and snapshot locations.
export.cli: Import experiment evidence or inspect a portable offline export.
export.cli_import: Explicitly import a file, MLflow or W&B selection into one portable file.
export.cli_request: Project-relative JSON import request; use schema evidence-import.
export.cli_out: New project-relative .pdevidence.json path; existing files are never replaced.
export.cli_inspect: Verify snapshot hashes and recomputed rows offline.
export.page: Use a nonnegative offset and a page limit from 1 to 100.
html.precision_stored-lexemes: Stored numeric text; original spreadsheet storage precision still applies.
html.precision_api-double: API double values; original pre-upload decimal precision cannot be recovered.
html.precision_sdk-binary64: SDK binary64 values preserved through round-trip text; earlier decimal precision cannot be recovered.
evidence.group_missing: A grouping identity is missing. This group cannot establish an experiment binding.
studio.precision_stored-lexemes: Stored numeric text; original spreadsheet storage precision still applies.
studio.precision_api-double: API double values; original pre-upload decimal precision cannot be recovered.
studio.precision_sdk-binary64: SDK binary64 values preserved through round-trip text; earlier decimal precision cannot be recovered.
statistics.level: Confidence level must be an explicit decimal string from 0.5 through 0.999.
statistics.contract: Declare the statistical reducer, ddof and unit of analysis together.
statistics.display: Sample-count suffixes and separate spread precision require a compound display.
statistics.expected: Statistics require an explicit complete seed/observation ID list matching the expected count; n must exceed ddof.
statistics.n_display: A statistical sample count requires integer display.
statistics.schema: Statistical declarations require configuration schema version 6.
statistics.report_schema: Statistical results require report schema version 6.
statistics.explicit_display: A statistical metric requires an explicit statistical display; scalar metrics cannot use it.
statistics.ci_required: Declare the confidence interval method, level and sampling assumption before binding its endpoints.
statistics.table_display: The statistical table anchor and occurrence must declare the same compound display.
statistics.numerics: The interval quantile did not meet the required numerical convergence check.
statistics.limit: Statistical observations support up to 100 significant digits and exponents/magnitudes within ±200.
statistics.seed_type: Observation IDs must use one explicitly declared string or integer type.
statistics.missing: A declared observation is missing its numeric value; no observations were dropped or imputed.
statistics.grammar: The selected text does not match the declared statistical display, units and sample-count suffix.
statistics.span: The complete statistical expression must occupy one supported source region.
statistics.selection: Select every number in one compound expression, including n when shown; do not mix locations.
statistics.result: Statistical result fields are missing, nonfinite or inconsistent.
statistics.sample_sd: Sample SD: divide squared deviations by n − 1
statistics.population_sd: Population SD: divide squared deviations by n
statistics.guide_ci: Calculate a two-sided Student-t confidence interval?
statistics.guide_level: Confidence level as a decimal, for example 0.95
statistics.assumption: Author-declared assumption: observations are independent draws from a normal population; this check does not establish that assumption.
statistics.assumption_accept: I explicitly declare this sampling assumption
statistics.guide_display: Select the statistical component or compound expression
statistics.no_significance: These are declared descriptive statistics and an approximate interval under the stated assumptions. A larger mean does not establish statistical significance.
studio.stats_contract_hint: Declare one row per observation and list every expected seed/observation ID. Missing values are never dropped.
studio.stats_display_hint: Choose the meaning of the displayed numbers explicitly. ± alone does not identify SD or SE.
studio.stats_selection: For a compound display, select every number in one expression, including n when present. Stage each expression separately.
studio.stats_spread_places: SD/SE or interval decimal places (blank: same as mean)
studio.stats_level: Confidence level as a decimal, for example 0.95
studio.stats_sample_sd: Sample SD: divide squared deviations by n − 1
studio.stats_population_sd: Population SD: divide squared deviations by n
studio.stats_assumption: Author-declared assumption: observations are independent draws from a normal population; this check does not establish that assumption.
studio.stats_no_significance: These are declared descriptive statistics and an approximate interval under the stated assumptions. A larger mean does not establish statistical significance.
statistics.repair_first: Select the first number of the complete statistical expression, then review the whole proposed location.
markdown.MARKDOWN_METADATA: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. Metadata or front matter is not evaluated.
markdown.MARKDOWN_DYNAMIC: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. Dynamic execution, math or renderer-dependent syntax is not evaluated.
markdown.MARKDOWN_CODE: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. Code content is not verified or executed.
markdown.MARKDOWN_HTML: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. Raw HTML and its visibility rules are not interpreted.
markdown.MARKDOWN_IMAGE: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. Image content and alternative text are not numeric manuscript evidence.
markdown.MARKDOWN_ENCODING: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. Transformed, split or visually uncertain numeric text is not verified.
markdown.MARKDOWN_REFERENCE: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. Citation, cross-reference and visible URL syntax is not resolved.
markdown.MARKDOWN_TABLE: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. This table cannot establish literal, regular cells and identities.
markdown.MARKDOWN_POSITION: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. This construct cannot be mapped to one reliable original source position.
markdown.MARKDOWN_PARSE: Unverified content at {file}:{line}. This static manuscript syntax is unsupported.
markdown.report_schema: Markdown/Quarto source positions require report schema 8.
document.PDF_PAGE_LIMIT: Page {page} exceeds the bounded text/graphics extraction limit. This page is unverified; other pages remain eligible for checking.
document.cell_schema: Reviewed multi-value cell or numeric-only context anchors require configuration schema 9.
document.cell_compound: Bind either one reviewed cell value or the complete declared statistical expression, not both.
document.table_identity: The reviewed headers and row labels must uniquely identify the selected original cell. Use exact labels in their original order; do not enter measurement values as row keys.
studio.table_identity_hint: For multi-row headers or numeric row labels: enter the header row count and exact identity cells from left to right. This must still resolve uniquely to every selected original value.
studio.table_identity_use: Use these explicitly reviewed row labels
studio.table_row_prefix: Row identity cells (one per line, starting at the left edge)
diagnostics.help: Preview anonymous local support metadata, then optionally save the reviewed ZIP.
diagnostics.out: New ZIP path inside the project; requires the exact preview ID.
diagnostics.preview_id: Hash returned by the preview you inspected.
diagnostics.notice: This is the complete bundle content. It contains runtime versions and diagnostic counts, excluding paper text, evidence, file names, personal paths and error messages. Nothing is uploaded.
diagnostics.changed: Preview the current diagnostic bundle first, then use its exact preview_id to save it.
studio.diagnostic_attest: I reviewed the exact content to export
native.read_original: Review this part in the original document; unsupported content is not a verified result.
native.pdf_region: Select a named PDF region with paperdelta pdf region-add and preview it; ambiguous or image-only regions remain unverified.
native.pdf_original: Check the original page. Use a text PDF or its editable source when the region has no reliable text; OCR is not performed.
native.word_grid: Review the original table grid, tracked changes and nested cells. Use an ordinary explicit grid or bind a supported source manuscript.
studio.diagnostic_notice: This is the complete bundle content. It contains runtime versions and diagnostic counts, excluding paper text, evidence, file names, personal paths and error messages. Nothing is uploaded.
document.numeric_context: A numeric-only context requires an original block and literal prefix/suffix boundaries.
advice.empty: No observed value; choose the type explicitly.
advice.leading_zero: Leading-zero values remain exact text identities.
advice.identity_name: The column name suggests an identity; keep its literal text.
advice.missing: Missing values require an explicit evidence policy.
advice.numeric: All inspected values parse exactly under this numeric type.
advice.text: Values require a text contract; no numeric conversion was inferred.
advice.declared: This contract was explicitly declared in the validated evidence export.
advice.key_unique: These named identity columns uniquely identify every observed row; confirm their experiment meaning.
advice.incomplete: The table is empty or exceeds the inspection limit; no complete uniqueness claim is made.
advice.no_key: No unique key was established from named identity columns. Add or choose an explicit experiment identity.
advice.experiment: Grouping uses column labels and repeated identities. Choose units, reduction and experiment scope explicitly.
advice.notice: Suggestions are unaccepted. Review types, identity, units and scope before applying them. Equal result values never establish identity.
advice.table_required: Choose a complete table or Excel range; nested JSON uses explicit pointer-based metric setup.
advice.native_numeric: Excel stores these cells as numbers; display formatting is not a text identity.
advice.mcp: Inspect conservative source types, candidate keys and grouping reasons. Suggestions remain unaccepted.
studio.source_advice_apply: Apply reviewed types and key to this form
studio.source_advice_applied: Reviewed suggestions filled the form. Check the contract and stage the source.
studio.source_advice_stale: Evidence changed after preview. Inspect the source again before applying suggestions.
advice.mixed_storage: Excel mixes numeric and text storage in an identity column. Review or normalize the source explicitly before applying a contract.
studio.batch_joint_toggle: Review evidence and original positions together
studio.batch_joint_count: Showing {shown} of {matches} strongest context matches; {total} positions remain inspectable. Numeric equality is not a match rule.
studio.batch_joint_all: Inspect all positions for this metric
studio.select_reviewed: Select all displayed bindings I have reviewed
mapping.session: This process-local mapping session expired or is absent. Start a new session.
mapping.revision: The session revision changed. Inspect the session before sending another action.
mapping.terminal: This session has ended. Inspect or export its draft; start a new session to continue.
mapping.order: Choose one of allowed_actions and reference only declared sources and metrics.
mapping.arguments: Use the selected stage schema; finish and abstain require empty arguments. Arguments must fit 128 KiB.
mapping.reason: Explain why the requested mapping cannot be supported, within 4000 characters.
mapping.hint_stale: Inputs changed. Start a new session and inspect the new evidence; the old draft is not repaired automatically.
mapping.hint_count: Inspect the contributing rows. Supply the declared count and exact seed set; abstain if the request does not justify them.
mapping.hint_source: Inspect the source contract, declared types and primary key. Preserve leading-zero identifiers and resolve duplicate identities before retrying.
mapping.hint_location: Inspect original candidate context and display settings. Choose a uniquely supported position; do not select by equal numeric values.
mapping.hint_arguments: Use the named fields and enums in stage_schemas and inspect preview.available_sources/available_metrics. Failed arguments did not alter the previous draft.
mapping.next: Inspect each experiment and original location. A completed session produces an unaccepted proposal; explicit acceptance happens in Studio or the CLI.
mapping.instructions: Use source, metric, derived and locations stages, then finish. Each stage has typed flat arguments. Keep the returned revision. At most 16 actions and 3 invalid actions are allowed; invalid stages preserve the last valid draft. Abstain when identity lacks evidence. Equal numbers never identify an experiment. No session writes project files.
mapping.mcp_start: Start a bounded read-only mapping session with schemas, discovery and allowed actions. Never accepts bindings.
mapping.mcp_inspect: Inspect or export the last valid process-local mapping draft without writing files.
mapping.mcp_advance: Advance one typed mapping stage with the current revision. Errors preserve the draft and return correction guidance. Finish deterministically checks an unaccepted proposal.
experiment.alias_column: Aliases must name an explicit grouping/filter identity column, never a result field.
experiment.alias_value: The alias identity is absent from the selected evidence. Review its type, spelling and filters.
experiment.alias_conflict: A paper label cannot refer to different values of the same identity column.
experiment.identity: The saved experiment definition does not match its fingerprint.
experiment.reference: A saved definition cannot contain another definition reference.
experiment.changed: The request or source contract differs from the shared definition. Review and save a new definition or explicitly use an independent request.
experiment.limit: Use at most 100 saved definitions, each within 128 KiB.
experiment.preview: Preview the current experiment definition again before confirming it.
experiment.notice: Review the source types, identity columns, units, reduction, counts, seeds and every alias. Saving this immutable definition does not accept paper bindings.
experiment.saved: Reviewed experiment definition saved. Reuse its fingerprint for later batches; accepted metric contracts remain snapshots.
experiment.loaded: Shared experiment definition loaded. Review its candidates before staging and accepting bindings.
experiment.rationale_limit: Shorten the binding rationale to leave room for the shared definition fingerprint (4000 characters total).
studio.experiment_advice_apply: Apply these fields and groups for review
studio.experiment_advice_review: Review the suggested groups and filters. Choose units, reduction, expected count and seeds explicitly.
studio.experiment_alias_hint: Declare a paper label for one exact source identity, with a reason. Labels only explain context suggestions; original anchors and explicit location selection remain required.
studio.experiment_definition_hint: Save the current settings and labels only after preview and confirmation. Changes create a new fingerprint. Accepted bindings keep their resolved contracts; they are never silently updated.

mapping.schema_identifier: New identifier, such as experiment_results. Letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen; start with a letter. Never a file path or a phrase with spaces.
mapping.schema_reference: Exact identifier already present in the available sources or metrics, never a file path.
mapping.schema_names: New binding identifiers, one per selected location; no spaces or path separators.
mapping.schema_columns: Required nonempty type map for csv/tsv/xlsx/records: string, integer or decimal for every used column. JSON pointer sources omit it.
mapping.schema_primary_key: Required for table sources: explicit identity columns uniquely distinguishing every record. Preserve their reviewed order; repeated-run columns usually follow experiment columns. Do not use a result value as identity.
mapping.schema_unit: Unit of the SOURCE field, independent of the paper display. For example raw 0.73 is fraction, raw 73 is percent when the task declares accuracy percentages. Verify the task's unit; never choose from the paper number alone.
mapping.schema_display: Paper formatting: percent converts a fraction to percent; decimal does not. Inspect the complete original token and surrounding context before selecting.
mapping.schema_percent_symbol: True when the selected original value includes a percent sign. LaTeX escaped percent signs are part of the original occurrence.
mapping.schema_expected_count: Explicit expected number of contributing evidence records. Required for all aggregations; derive it only from the requested experimental contract and evidence.
mapping.schema_where: Exact source identity selectors; every value must be a string, including seeds. Declared column types determine meaning. Insufficient identity evidence requires abstention.
ci.delta.title: ## Finding transitions
ci.delta.scope: Compared with the saved snapshot read from the target commit. This is not a fresh execution of target data. Removing a binding or changing its contract does not establish resolution.
ci.delta.none: No binding-status transitions or current failures.
ci.delta.unavailable: No target snapshot is available; current findings are shown without inventing additions or resolutions.
ci.delta.contract: The snapshot configuration does not match the target configuration. Passing results after a changed or unknown contract are not counted as resolved failures.
ci.delta.full: Each category displays up to 50 entries; ci-context.json retains the complete lists. Changed contracts may also have current failures.
